description: Orientation of the phone from gravity and the magnetic field. Input: gravity, the part of the acceleration due to gravity on the axes of the catalog (pointing up, about +9.81 on z when the phone lies flat with the screen up), in m/s²; magneticField, the calibrated magnetic field on the same axes in µT, or null. Expected: values, roll, pitch, and yaw rounded to the resolution of the catalog; yaw is left out without a magnetic field. See sensors.md, Orientation.
